idea: Shapes (Friday school readiness, long 2:40 learning song) in the BACKYARD: a big red foam circle bounces up right beside Baby Jimmy's face ('Boing! Wow! Look! A big red circle!'); chorus 'Circle, square, triangle, star! Shapes, shapes – here they are! … Clap with me – you're a star!'; each verse starts with a new shape popping up beside him – red circle (draw a circle in the air), blue square (one, two, three, four sides; clap four times), green triangle (one, two, three sides; pointy roof with the arms), yellow star (a star like the one on his onesie; wiggle your fingers); clap break; review row of all four shapes and the question 'Which one is the star? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'The yellow star! Yay!'; loop: the hook framing with the red circle, bye-bye wave.

learning.goal: Name four shapes: circle, square, triangle, star (square = 4 sides, triangle = 3 sides)
learning.shown_how: one big chunky foam shape in one pure color pops up beside Jimmy per verse (red circle, blue square, green triangle, yellow star); review row of all four
learning.song_repeats: chorus x4 names all four; each verse names its shape 4+ times; review at 1:54
learning.interactive_moment: 2:02 'Which one is the star? Hmm?' + 2 s pause, answer 2:06
learning.copy_me: draw a circle in the air, clap four times, pointy roof with the arms, wiggle fingers, clap break 1:42
learning.fact_check: square 4 sides, triangle 3 sides, star 5 points; only the verse's shape visible in each verse shot; review row = exactly 4 shapes (counted)
learning.toddler_fit: one baby, sunny calm backyard, big face, soft foam shapes

story_order: circle from hook; square from 0:38; triangle from 1:10; star from 1:26; choruses 1-2 show no shapes; all four only from the review (1:54) / final chorus

shots.role: HOOK – red circle bounces up beside his face, gasp
CHORUS B – standing dance arms up
CIRCLE – hand round and round, circle turns (redo -r1; first take drew red lines over his face)
TRIANGLE – arms as a pointy roof, green triangle
STAR – taps the star on his onesie, yellow star spins
CLAP BREAK – claps above head (frame redone: first frame too small)
REVIEW – four shapes in a row, pointing, curious
ANSWER – waves the yellow star, cheering
FINAL CHORUS – dancing among the four shapes
LOOP ENDING – edit of hook frame, bye-bye wave
